dev_01.reason: Bare columns/SELECT * under GROUP BY have implementation-dependent representative semantics; keep SQLite replay and reverse insertion control, mark DIALECT_UNKNOWN.

dev_02.reason: Equality/group/count/distinct with non-NULL strings and explicit official all-cross neq profile; compare result bags, retain original ORDER BY.

dev_03.reason: AVG vs integer SUM/COUNT division and ROUND is the already exposed dialect control; any difference is DIALECT_UNKNOWN, never an advantage or natural-defect success.

dev_04.reason: INT32 keys, strict non-NULL FK, NOT IN vs natural-left-join/count; a nullable FK poison witness is invalid under this profile.

dev_05.reason: Account and name are separate PKs, so bare name grouping is functionally determined; equality/group/INT32 SUM under exact two rows remains within int64.

dev_06.reason: Strict FK excludes unmatched BOXES; nonnegative INT32 counts with two rows and SUM/add/IFNULL remain int64 safe.

AST_source: Only exactly two parsed_asts from SHA-pinned official_smoke_report per case, bound original_SQL/schema/C hashes. Missing or unbound data stays AST_FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE and C remains NOT_RUN. No SQL-text feature reconstruction or guessed AST.

C.limitations: Heuristic feature ordering only; no completeness improvement, learned weights, query-output tuning, AST repair, or extra candidate pool.

selection_timing: Weights and pool were authored before parent supplied smoke per-case outcomes. Actual AST node-name mapping nin->notin and provenance were added after reading only projected parsed_asts/hash fields; no ranking weights or database values changed based on outcomes. Prior outcomes and development source exposure are disclosed, not treated as a hidden test.

comparison.per_candidate: rehash rows/schema/C; independently check complete original OperationalIC; execute both original SQL and record each slot durably
comparison.first_difference: Only dev02/04/05/06; recheck C and rerun both unchanged SQL on fresh DB, require stable per-side output bags before first validated difference stop
comparison.dev01: Never scientific SAT; preserve DIALECT_UNKNOWN and reverse insertion diagnostic if differing; continue entire shared pool
comparison.dev03: Never scientific SAT; preserve DIALECT_UNKNOWN and continue entire shared pool
comparison.not_found: NOT_FOUND means no validated witness in these attempted fixed DBs; never equivalence. Failures retained separately; remaining slots NOT_RUN on limits.

durability: Exclusive new event log; fsync complete matrix and frozen orders before SQL, then every probe START/END and every SQL slot START/END. START without terminal event is ATTEMPTED_EFFECT_UNKNOWN; unstarted registered work is NOT_RUN. Arm checkpoint reports are secondary to event log.

cost_accounting.arm_budget_debit: Method-specific ordering CPU/wall charged before each identical probe budget; shared preparation counted in whole worker and listed separately. No ranking/validation failure is free.
cost_accounting.standalone_scenario_rule: Add the entire applicable shared preprocessing cost to each standalone B or C scenario; do not divide it by12 or hide it as free. Original artificial-pool construction cost from probe_pool_manifest is a separate one-time shared preparation dependency.
cost_accounting.historical_frontend: Pinned smoke parser and import stage costs are historical predecessor evidence, not freshly timed frontend; missing costs are unknown, not zero. Smoke solver cost must not be relabeled preprocessing.
cost_accounting.complete_process_totals: Only external supervisor totals include imports before main plus final fsync/cleanup/close; local per-arm clocks do not replace them.
cost_accounting.claims: Report probe cost and dependency on official smoke only; no end-to-end fused-vs-fallback speedup.

fallback.pure_fallback_ablation: Existing official smoke is shared dependency evidence; not rerun by this worker and not paired cold-timing evidence. fusion_plan returns a deferred descriptor only.
fallback.stop_gate: If B and C both completely and successfully scan every frozen candidate with zero validated differences on dev02/04/05/06, stop fallback-savings claim: neither permutation avoids fallback here, no repeated solver necessary. Missing AST/failed/truncated arms cannot pass this gate.

scientific_position: Known XData-style probe ordering plus VeriEQL fallback engineering diagnostic, all six groups exposed. Expected possible zero increment; preserve it. No natural-defect gold, unseen-test, equivalence, new-mechanism, or automatic-promotion claim.
authoring_validation: Python AST syntax parse only; target module not imported or executed; no SQL/solver invoked by ordering author.
